about.intro:
Hi, I'm Francesco, I'm 24 years old, and welcome to my portfolio.
I currently work as an IT Technician at ITS Academy Mobilità and I'm a Junior Front-End Developer with Back-End skills as well. For Front-End I use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Tailwind CSS. For Back-End I've studied Node.js and relational databases like PostgreSQL as well as non-relational ones like MongoDB.
I'm a dynamic person passionate about IT, both hardware and software. I love learning continuously and improving my skills: I earned a web development certification from Develhope, and my mission is to turn ideas into functional technological solutions.
about.exp1Description: Since June 10, 2025 I've been working as an IT Technician at ITS Academy Mobilità: IT infrastructure management and maintenance, technical support and hardware/software assistance.
about.exp2Description: Web development certification: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js and relational and non-relational databases.

projects.title: MY PROJECTS
projects.byCycleDescription: An online community dedicated to all cycling enthusiasts. It allows you to log in and out, interact with other users, start discussions, discover new cycling routes across Europe with details and maps, delete your account, and much more!
projects.eaDescription: My first team project, built entirely in Vanilla: HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We recreated the famous <ea>Electronic Arts</ea> website in detail, almost to perfection!
projects.reactLandingDescription: A landing page built with React, developed in my free time to experiment with components and animations.
projects.vanillaLandingDescription: Another landing page, built only with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, based on a real-world example.
